text:
ellie: design check - latest mock for roles matrix density + invite modal tweaks: https://www.figma.com/file/ABC/roles-invite-v4 (frames: Density, InviteModal). want to resolve spacing vs scannability before we freeze styles.
noah: quick ask: will the compact rows hide role descriptions? customers asked for hover/explainers.
jr-frontend: compact rows are possible, but we should avoid truncating label text. could move descriptions into an expandable panel per role.
ellie: proposal: default compact (2 rows per role) with a chevron to expand details. keeps table height low for orgs with 200+ roles.
sam-a11y: a few nits from keyboard/screen reader POV:
- expanding chevron must be a proper button with aria-expanded
- role rows should have `role=row` and the expand control `aria-controls` target id for screen readers
- if we use hover tooltips for descriptions, provide accessible alternative (aria-describedby or hidden region)
jr-frontend: agreed. I'll switch tooltip to an accessible popover and add `aria-describedby` linking to the hidden element.
noah: invite modal: debate between inline SSO enforcement checkbox vs full-screen step. which is less disruptive?
ellie: UX opinion: keep it inline in the modal as a switch labelled clearly. avoid forcing a separate modal step. less friction.
sam-a11y: copy matters. Suggested aria-friendly text for the switch:
`<button role="switch" aria-checked="true" id="sso-switch">Require SSO for invited members</button>`
plus helper text: "Existing members unaffected. Requires users to complete your org's SSO during signup."
noah: good. product prefers shorter label on the control and longer helper copy beneath. e.g., control: "Require SSO" helper: "New invites must sign in with SSO. Existing members unchanged."
ellie: will mock both variants in figma. prefer helper that reads conversationally.
jr-frontend: implementation note: the switch needs keyboard focus styles. current design uses thin 1px outline in focus state which fails 3:1. i'll bump to 3px visible ring.
sam-a11y: also ensure the invite modal uses `aria-labelledby` and that error summaries are announced with `aria-live="assertive"` when invite fails. screen reader users otherwise miss the row-level errors.
ops-bot: deploy-staging: roles-invite-compact branch deployed at 2024-12-03T09:14:01Z :rocket:
jr-frontend: i pushed a small PR converting role-row to `tr` semantics and added the expand button ARIA attributes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/web/pull/4390
ellie: awesome. last UI debate: role badge color. product wants color to communicate severity (admin vs read-only), but a11y warns on pure color meaning.
sam-a11y: never use color alone. add iconography or text label and ensure contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for small text or use larger text for tokens.
oah: ok scope: ellie to update figma with expanded helper copy + explicit icon variants. jr to land ARIA updates and strong focus styles. sam to run quick a11y sweep on staging after PR merge. i'll capture decisions in the spec doc and update release checklist. :thumbsup:
ellie: i'll upload new frames and tag you all. leaving thread open for staging feedback. :eyes:
